steps.title: Hi, I'm MIA
steps.say: I'm a personal assistant that turns real life into a game. Everything you're about to see comes from things that really happened, and none of it ever leaves this house.
steps.name: Robin

steps.title: Level 2
steps.say: Every real thing done earns experience: workouts, missions, builds, upkeep. That's level 2, 65% of the way to the next.

steps.title: Real Character Stats
steps.say: Six stats, like a character sheet, made from what's really done. Training only goes up; a quiet month never takes anything away.

steps.title: Buffs
steps.say: Good streaks earn buffs, and each one lifts a stat. There are no debuffs, ever.

steps.title: Missions And Boss Fights
steps.say: Goals become missions with objectives, and the big ones become boss fights with an HP bar.

steps.title: Gear Like Equipment
steps.say: The mower, the truck, the house: each has a condition bar that wears down as upkeep comes due and fills back up when it's done.

steps.title: Crafting Recipes
steps.say: Things built in the workshop are saved like crafting recipes: what they need, the cuts, the steps. I check what's on the shelf and make the shopping list for what's missing.

steps.title: The Chronicle
steps.say: Every week I write the story of it, from what really happened.
steps.name: The Training Week
story: This was a week of sweat.

steps.title: On The Glasses
steps.say: The same MIA shows up on smart glasses: missions, upkeep and recipes in the corner of your eye, and the XP when something's done.

steps.title: Ask Me Anything Later
steps.say: That's the tour. Afterwards, try asking me what's next on a mission, how a build is going, or to start a recipe. Thanks for watching!
